correctness.rationale: For any degree n the Fourier logarithm expansion converges in L², so Parseval identifies variance as one half the squared-power-sum sum. The Bernoulli kernel gives an exact ordered-angle quadratic; its Hessian is n/2 times orthogonal projection off constants and its value at equispaced roots is pi²/12. Projecting this exact quadratic onto contiguous equal-angle blocks forces each cluster to its arithmetic-mean regular-grid location and yields the within-block sum of squares pi² m(m²−1)/(3 n²). The result is the cubic minimum pi² sum m³/(12n) plus a nonnegative weighted squared-displacement term. The weighted target gaps are positive and total 2pi, hence all are admissible. Equality is precisely rotation of that target, including r=1. Strict convexity of k³ under pair-balancing proves the r-only classification. Standalone exact Fraction arithmetic confirms all 1023 compositions in degrees 1..10 but is supplementary, not an infinite proof.
